doorkey.T: one committed search step. The prompt index t is that beat. T is not a column of X.
doorkey.Y: episode success, 1 if the search returns a solved state else 0. Written onto every step of that episode only after the episode ends. The query beat does not contain Y.

feature_selection.note: reference Y does not vary, so every column has vimp 0 and no column is sent to the residual

Y is 1 if this episode's search returned a solved state, else 0.
